name: Moonlit Quill Woods
description: A forest where silver quills grow like trees, writing luminous scripts in the night air.
prompt: Moonlit forest where tall silver quill-like trees sprout, their bark textured like ancient quills, emitting faint glowing scripts in the air, soft silver moonlight filtering through.
caption: The forest writes itself in silver—Moonlit Quill Woods never cease to amaze. 🌰✨
